news.admin module¶

Admin configuration for managing users, publishers, and content.

Registers the CustomUser, Publisher, Article, and Newsletter models with the Django admin site and customizes their list displays, filters, search fields, fieldsets, and horizontal relation widgets.

news.api_views module¶

API views for article management and approval webhook logging.

Provides the ArticleViewSet for role-based article CRUD operations and subscribed feed retrieval, as well as the approved_article_webhook endpoint for logging signal-triggered article approvals.

class news.api_views.ArticleViewSet(**kwargs)¶

Bases: ModelViewSet

Manage article CRUD operations per user role and subscriptions.

Handles article queryset and action access based on user role and subscriptions.

get_queryset()¶

Return articles visible to the current user role.

Editors and superusers receive all articles, journalists receive approved articles plus their own drafts, and all other users receive only approved articles, ordered newest first.

permission_classes = [<class 'news.permissions.IsEditorOrAuthorOrReadOnly'>]¶
serializer_class¶

alias of ArticleSerializer

subscribed(request)¶

Return articles matching the reader’s subscriptions.

Handles GET /api/articles/subscribed/ requests.

news.api_views.approved_article_webhook(request, *args, **kwargs)¶

Log approved article payloads received from approval signals.

Handles internal POST /api/approved/ requests[cite: 6, 7].

news.permissions module¶

Custom Django REST Framework permissions for role-based access control.

Defines permission classes restricting API actions by Journalist, Editor, and article authorship roles.

class news.permissions.IsEditor¶

Bases: BasePermission

Permits access only to users with the Editor role.

has_permission(request, view)¶

Allow access if user is an editor or superuser.

class news.permissions.IsEditorOrAuthorOrReadOnly¶

Bases: BasePermission

Control article access by user role and authorship.

  • Safe methods (GET, HEAD, OPTIONS): open to authenticated users.

  • POST: Only journalists can create articles.

  • PUT, PATCH, DELETE: Only Editors or the original authoring Journalist.

has_object_permission(request, view, obj)¶

Allow edits by editors, superusers, or the article author.

has_permission(request, view)¶

Check view-level permissions based on role and HTTP method.

class news.permissions.IsJournalist¶

Bases: BasePermission

Permits access only to users with the Journalist role.

has_permission(request, view)¶

Allow access if user is a journalist or superuser.

news.signals module¶

Django signal handlers for article publication workflows.

Listens for Article post-save events to email subscribed readers and notify the internal approval webhook endpoint when an article is approved.

news.signals.handle_article_approval(sender, instance, created, **kwargs)¶

Triggers subscriber notifications and internal API logging.

news.tests module¶

Automated test suite for the news application API and signals.

Covers token authentication, role-based permissions, subscription feed filtering, approval signal notifications, and newsletters.

news.urls module¶

URL routing configuration for the news application.

Maps web interface views, authentication routes, editorial and admin approval endpoints, and RESTful API viewset/token routes.
